descriptionChirho: Active causative meaning in the Hifil stem: to save, deliver, or rescue someone from danger, enemies, or distress, with God or a human agent as subject (Arabic khallasa/anqadha, Korean guwonhada, Swahili -okoa).

Hifil participle used substantively as an agent noun or title: savior, deliverer, rescuer, often with possessive suffixes or the article, designating God or a human champion (Arabic mukhallis, Korean guwonJa, Swahili mwokozi).

Passive or reflexive meaning in the Nifal stem: to be saved, to be delivered, to receive or experience salvation, with the rescued party as subject (Arabic khullisa/yakhlus, Korean guwon-batda, Swahili -okolewa).
Abstract feminine noun denoting the state or act of salvation, deliverance, or rescue (Arabic najda, Korean guwon, Swahili wokovu).
